The '''Volz Complex''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] hidden in the [[Wikipedia:Stipe (mycology)|stipe]] of a [[Giant Fungi Forest|gigantic fungus]]<ref name="The Second Kessel Run" /> located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Little Kessel]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> There, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]] did his most advanced research.<ref name="The Second Kessel Run" />
